description: Default capability for the main SyncBlaze window
_comment: App-level #[tauri::command] functions registered via invoke_handler (get_lan_info, start_google_signin) are callable under core:default in current Tauri v2 releases. If a future version tightens this, add its specific permission id here — check `cargo tauri dev`'s console for the exact permission it's asking for. opener:default is here for tauri-plugin-opener, used internally by start_google_signin to open the system browser.
